text: BAM's share of Solana stake eased to 34.0% (147.7M SOL) over the past 27 hours. Just 3 of the 15 live nodes hold a majority of marketplace stake, with the largest at 24.6% and 91 validators concentrated on the busiest node in fra. The top node by stake changed hands 69 times in this window — whale-driven routing, not structural rollovers.
